ambiguities_or_notes: Exact audited Russian Markdown source bytes were revalidated in this runtime against the pinned SHA-256.
All four printed page markers, the complete discussion of chapters I-VI of Catherine II's Instruction, all Latin quotations, and all twenty-nine notes are represented.
Latin quotations remain in the body exactly as supplied by the audited source; the edition's Russian glosses are translated into English in the notes.
Natural law and positive law are kept as separate juridical terms; Tolstoy's abrupt judgments about Catherine and about women's minds are not softened.
The marginal why? attached to the quotation about obedience to one master and all deleted/restored readings are preserved in the apparatus.
